command:
set +e
parent_pid=$$
parent_cgroup=$(cat /proc/self/cgroup | tr '\n' ';')
memory_max=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max)
pids_max=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/pids.max)
parent_threads=$(awk '/^Threads:/ {print $2}' /proc/$$/status)
echo "parent_pid=$parent_pid"
echo "parent_cgroup=$parent_cgroup"
echo "memory_max_bytes=$memory_max"
echo "pids_max=$pids_max"
echo "parent_threads=$parent_threads"
echo "memory_events_before=$(tr '\n' ';' < /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events)"
/bin/sh -c 'echo child_pid=$$; echo child_cgroup=$(cat /proc/self/cgroup | tr "\n" ";"); dd if=/dev/zero of=/tmp/fill bs=1M count=512; rc=$?; echo dd_exit=$rc; exit 0' >/tmp/child.out 2>&1 &
child=$!
echo "child_shell_pid=$child"
echo "child_cgroup_from_parent=$(cat /proc/$child/cgroup 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ';')"
echo "pids_current_during=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/pids.current)"
wait "$child"
child_wait=$?
echo "child_shell_wait_status=$child_wait"
echo 'child_output_begin'
cat /tmp/child.out
echo 'child_output_end'
events=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events)
echo 'memory_events_after_begin'
printf '%s\n' "$events"
echo 'memory_events_after_end'
printf '%s\n' "$events" | grep -q '^oom_kill [1-9][0-9]*$'
kill_seen=$?
printf '%s\n' "$events" | grep -q '^max [1-9][0-9]*$'
max_seen=$?
echo "oom_kill_event_seen=$((kill_seen == 0))"
echo "memory_max_event_seen=$((max_seen == 0))"
echo "pids_current_after=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/pids.current)"
[ "$memory_max" = 268435456 ] || exit 20
[ "$kill_seen" = 0 ] && [ "$max_seen" = 0 ] || exit 21
stdout:
parent_pid=1
parent_cgroup=0::/;
memory_max_bytes=268435456
pids_max=16
parent_threads=1
memory_events_before=low 0;high 0;max 0;oom 0;oom_kill 0;oom_group_kill 0;sock_throttled 0;
child_shell_pid=13
child_cgroup_from_parent=0::/;
pids_current_during=3
child_shell_wait_status=0
child_output_begin
child_pid=13
child_cgroup=0::/;
Killed
dd_exit=137
child_output_end
memory_events_after_begin
low 0
high 0
max 1460
oom 1
oom_kill 1
oom_group_kill 0
sock_throttled 0
memory_events_after_end
oom_kill_event_seen=1
memory_max_event_seen=1
pids_current_after=2
